target.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Ollama web search did not resolve env-backed SecretRefs configured at `models.providers.ollama.apiKey`. Treating an explicitly configured but unavailable SecretRef as no configuration could also select an unrelated ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` and route the query to Ollama Cloud.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Ollama runtime now delegates literal and env-backed SecretRef resolution to the existing shared `resolveWebSearchProviderCredential(...)` helper. The plugin separately preserves whether the configured input was a SecretRef, so a missing or unsupported ref fails before any request without expanding the Plugin SDK. Literal configured keys and the independent ambient cloud key remain separate, preserving the selected-host attempts plus authenticated cloud fallback used by mixed setups.

## User Impact

Users can configure an env SecretRef for the Ollama provider key and have the resolved value sent on web-search requests. Missing or non-env SecretRefs fail before `fetchWithSsrFGuard` instead of silently using an unrelated ambient key. Existing marker-string fallback to `OLLAMA_API_KEY` and mixed configured-key/ambient-key cloud fallback remain covered.

## Evidence

- Current PR diff is limited to `extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.ts` and `extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.test.ts`; Plugin SDK, core credential helper, packages, and generated API baseline have zero diff.
- The configured-ref path calls the shared resolver, uses the public `coerceSecretRef(...)` contract to retain explicit-ref state, and rejects an unavailable ref before request construction.
- Focused tests cover resolved env refs, missing env refs with an ambient key present, unsupported non-env refs, mixed literal configured and ambient keys, and marker-string fallback.

## Proof

- Exact pushed head: `7048ae448971bcb4c5c9305840197000c6301d0b`.
- The branch ordinarily merged OpenClaw main at `e10d8051d3a1ba7fd96eb4bb30a28c2107d4bdce`; no rebase or force-push was used. The PR result relative to that main remains exactly the two Ollama files.
- The only merge conflict was current main's removal of the internal `testing` export and conversion of adjacent tests to the public provider/tool path. The resolution keeps that main refactor and preserves this PR's credential logic; the configured-credential hunk is unchanged from pre-sync head `678f9c48b35041ecac98df380393d2199406c8c6`.
- The redacted loopback runtime proof on that patch-exact credential implementation called the real `runOllamaWebSearch` path while a test transport shim routed guarded requests to a local HTTP server. No provider credentials or external endpoints were used:
  - resolved env SecretRef: one request to the hosted path, authorization role `resolved`, result count 1;
  - unavailable env SecretRef with ambient key present: zero requests and the named fail-closed diagnostic;
  - unsupported non-env SecretRef with ambient key present: zero requests and the fail-closed diagnostic;
  - configured selected-host key plus ambient cloud key: three requests to local proxy, local hosted, then cloud hosted paths, with authorization roles `configured`, `configured`, `ambient`; 404, 404, 200 produced result count 1.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.test.ts` passed on the synchronized result: 1 file, 19 tests.
- Target `oxfmt`, direct target `oxlint --deny-warnings`, and `git diff --check` passed. The repository lint wrapper could not prepare Plugin SDK boundary artifacts with the stale shared local dependency snapshot; exact-head CI `check-lint`, `check-test-types`, and the extension package boundary check all passed.
- Exact-head CI run [29378574478](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29378574478) passed `openclaw/ci-gate`, build, tests, types, lint, QA smoke, dependency guard, and security checks. Three unrelated macOS/iOS Periphery jobs remain queued for repository runner capacity.
- Fresh autoreview was attempted on the synchronized result, but its bundle preflight rejected synthetic credential fixtures as secret-like before model invocation. The same credential implementation at pre-merge head `a6e84b3ec6f6693949514e710892b60257a5278c` had already passed Claude autoreview with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Sanitized AWS Crabbox could not be dispatched because the installed trusted client has no configured coordinator and the required empty-instance-profile preflight could not be proven. Exact-head fork CI is the authoritative remote validation path.
